items.https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c3x2: Anthropic, maker of the Claude chatbot, listed on the Nasdaq at $83 a share, briefly pushing its valuation near $2 trillion before shares settled around $97, still up about 17%. It is the first pure AI company to go public, and the volatile debut is seen as a key test of whether investors believe AI's huge spending will pay off.
items.https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/2: Democrats Jamie Raskin, Richard Blumenthal and Adam Schiff say an investigation found law firm Kirkland & Ellis gave at least $11.8m in free legal work to the Trump administration. They call it evidence of 'official coercion,' noting Trump has threatened firms with loss of security clearances and contracts, pushing some into free-service settlements. They have asked nine other firms for similar records.
items.https://www.theguardian.com/environment/: Five centuries-old, 20-tonne baobab trees dug up in South Africa for export to Georgia, reportedly without proper permits, are being replanted at a reserve after being intercepted and held in a Durban warehouse since July. Authorities did not name the intended buyer. A similar case occurred in Kenya, where trees were sent to a park owned by Georgian billionaire Bidzina Ivanishvili.
items.https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx7v: BBC spoke to seven residents trapped in Taiz, Yemen's third-largest city, which Houthi rebels fully encircled last month, cutting off food and other supplies to its roughly 600,000-1 million people. One mother described telling her son loud sounds are 'just fireworks' to shield him from the reality of living under siege. The accounts reveal severe shortages and rising prices for staples like rice and sugar.
items.https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/2: Malawi is facing a severe fuel shortage, forcing motorists to wait hours or entire nights at filling stations, with violent scuffles breaking out as queues turn chaotic. One driver described taking four hours to get just 20 litres of fuel. The crisis is disrupting daily business and transport across the country despite official schedules meant to manage supply.
items.https://www.theguardian.com/global-devel: A UN Population Fund report finds one in four women worldwide cannot refuse sex with their husband or partner. Almost half of women in west and central Africa, and a third in east/southern Africa and Arab states, lack this power, with girls aged 15-19 even more vulnerable than older women. Researchers link this to high rates of intimate partner violence.
items.https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c804: The International Court of Justice ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, the first time any state has been found guilty of genocide by an international court. Judges found 'intentional' destruction of the group during a 2017 military crackdown that killed thousands and displaced over 700,000 people, voting 9-6. Myanmar denies the findings, saying it acted against armed groups.
items.https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed: Haitian police say at least 34 gang members were killed in a raid in Martissant, a Port-au-Prince neighborhood. The operation is part of a broader crackdown since El Salvador sent about 2,500 troops in October to help Haiti's government fight gangs that control large parts of the capital.
items.https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/n: Fears are rising that the US could sanction International Court of Justice judges, including Nobel laureate Navi Pillay, after the court ruled Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya. Lawyers see the ruling as a precedent that could affect a future ICJ judgment on Israel's actions in Gaza, which Washington might view as crossing a line, prompting judges to seek advice on protecting their assets.
items.https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckzd: European leaders meeting in Berlin said they have a unified position and are ready to negotiate with Russia on ending the Ukraine war, rejecting Moscow's 'maximalist demands.' The summit followed Trump's trilateral talks with Putin and Xi in China; Trump's envoy Jared Kushner said the US wants a deal 'with Europe by his side,' though Putin has resisted a European role.
items.https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/m: Madhya Pradesh's Cabinet scrapped its 25-year-old two-child policy for government employees, which had barred those with more than two children from government jobs or promotions. Chief Minister Mohan Yadav cited India's declining birth rate as the reason. The 2001 rule, introduced to curb population growth, had caused hardship for many government employees, officials said.
items.https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/resignat: Justice Yashwant Varma told the Lok Sabha Secretariat his resignation isn't an admission of guilt, responding to an inquiry committee report in a September letter to the Secretary General.
items.https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new: Schools across several Odisha districts, including Khordha, Cuttack and Puri, are closed as Cyclone Akvan approaches, with some closures lasting through November 21. The precautionary holidays cover government and private schools, colleges and Anganwadi centres, as authorities brace for heavy rain and strong winds from the severe cyclonic storm.
items.https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/m: Maharashtra's government has withdrawn a court petition filed by its Food and Drug Administration against FSSAI, which had challenged the constitutional validity of food-safety regulations as encroaching on state powers. The petition, filed in September, had created friction between the Centre and the state despite both being governed by the BJP.
items.https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/47-train: Odisha evacuated over 3 lakh people and cancelled 47 trains as Cyclone Akvan approaches, with Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi reviewing preparedness and response measures.
items.https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new: India and Bangladesh risk letting their three-decade Ganga Water Treaty lapse on December 12, as formal renewal talks have yet to begin amid strained bilateral ties. Bangladesh's water minister wrote to his Indian counterpart on November 17 seeking talks, but officials see little chance of even a stopgap arrangement given disputes like climate change's effect on river flow.
items.https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/e: Home Minister Amit Shah said the Multi-Agency Centre, India's central intelligence-sharing platform under the Intelligence Bureau, now also tracks radicalisation hotspots alongside cybersecurity, narcotics and organised crime. Speaking at an anti-terrorism conference, he urged state anti-terror squads to strengthen cyber-expertise, noting the network was revamped in 2025 to connect all police districts securely.
items.https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/uttarakh: A bank manager and two agents were arrested in Uttarakhand for allegedly demanding a Rs 9 lakh bribe - 5% of a Rs 1.8 crore loan - to approve and disburse the loan.
items.https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new: Justice Yashwant Varma told the Lok Sabha Secretariat he is innocent of allegations over burnt currency notes found at his residence, insisting his April resignation shouldn't be read as admitting wrongdoing. He argued, citing a 1978 Supreme Court ruling, that a judge's resignation takes effect on its own and that removal proceedings against him became invalid once he quit.
items.https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/ind: Nike will become Formula One's official apparel and uniform partner from 2027, supplying co-branded uniforms for event staff plus fan apparel and accessories. The deal also includes Nike supporting F1 Academy, the sport's all-female development series, and will launch with a limited Las Vegas Grand Prix collection, as F1 builds its brand through major sponsorship tie-ups.
items.https://www.business-standard.com/compan: Tata Trusts' board meets on November 20 to discuss grant approvals; the proposed Tata Sons listing is not on the agenda, ahead of a separate Tata Sons board meeting on November 26.
items.https://www.livemint.com/companies/anthr: Anthropic's shares jumped as much as 21% above its $83 IPO price after a record $107.3bn debut that topped SpaceX's offering. Shares opened at $111.50, later trading near $100, giving Anthropic a fully diluted value of about $1.8 trillion - among the world's 10 biggest public companies, rivaling SpaceX and briefly challenging Amazon, even as the broader market fell.
items.https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/new: Indian customs authorities are reclassifying bulk Scotch whisky imports under a tariff code that doubles duty rates, following the India-UK trade agreement; trade body GTRI says customs should review this. Importers had been using a code for spirits that qualified for reduced duties, but customs now disputes that classification, creating a tariff dispute for whisky importers.
items.https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-ma: Indian markets were set to open lower as Asian shares fell on renewed worries over AI valuations, despite Anthropic's record IPO. Japan's Nikkei dropped 4.54%, South Korea's Kospi fell 4.74%, extending a seven-session losing streak for the MSCI Asia-Pacific index. This follows Thursday's rally when the Sensex and Nifty hit nine-month highs, showing how global AI-stock jitters can quickly spill into Indian trading.
items.https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/ind: Investment outcomes often depend more on investor behaviour than the product chosen. MOKSH Finserv partner Tirth Gala outlines five biases - including loss aversion and anchoring - and habits that help investors stay disciplined.
items.https://www.business-standard.com/compan: Bharti Airtel overtook HDFC Bank to become India's most valuable brand in Kantar's 2026 ranking, with its brand value rising 5% to $43.2 billion. It's the first time a telecom company has topped the list since the rankings began in 2014, reflecting Airtel's growing scale as India's telecom and digital-services leader.
items.https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/: Motilal Oswal Alternates launched its first commercial real estate fund, aiming to raise up to Rs 3,000 crore for early-stage investments in Grade A office projects across cities including Bengaluru, Mumbai and Pune. The eight-year fund, registered as a SEBI Category II AIF, will partner with developers via equity joint ventures, betting that office demand continues to outpace supply.
items.https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/new: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal called for India and the US to build 'trusted' supply chains and deepen economic cooperation, arguing India's talent and manufacturing strength complements America's capital and technology. He also urged more educational partnerships and said he is optimistic India can hit $1 trillion in exports this fiscal year.
items.https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-ma: Market analyst Raja Venkatraman's picks for November 20 include Gabriel, Motherson Sumi Wiring and Godrej Consumer, as Indian markets consolidated near Nifty's 25,000 mark after a strong rally, supported by foreign inflows and easing crude prices.
items.https://inc42.com/buzz/paytm-lines-up-%e: Paytm's board approved investing up to Rs 200 crore in Singapore's Funding Societies, including Rs 162 crore for a 19.1% stake in payments firm CardUp. Paytm will provide payments and lending technology to CardUp for fees and revenue share, part of its international expansion, with the deal expected to close by May 2027.
items.https://entrackr.com/snippets/inprime-fi: Bengaluru-based NBFC InPrime Finserv raised Rs 101 crore (~$10.7m) in a Series B round led by Dutch development bank FMO, with existing investors Z47 and Pravega Ventures also joining. The AI-first lender, which serves India's informal economy like kirana stores and small retailers, will use the funds to expand lending, strengthen AI underwriting and launch micro-mortgage products.
items.https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tec: Adhiraj Chauhan won 'Young AI Entrepreneur' at the ET AI Awards 2026 for AI innovations spanning mental healthcare, digital twins and marine robotics, standing out among startups and established enterprises.
items.https://inc42.com/features/can-sharechat: ShareChat parent Mohalla Tech crossed Rs 1,000 crore in annual revenue for the first time in FY26, up 40.5%, driven partly by its microdrama app QuickTV as it tries to reduce reliance on ad revenue. But its net loss widened to Rs 1,978 crore, largely due to share-based payments that jumped 302% to Rs 739 crore, raising questions about the quality of its growth.
items.https://entrackr.com/all-article/paytm-p: Shares of Paytm, Pine Labs and MobiKwik fell over 7% after reports that a planned merchant discount rate on high-value UPI transactions could be delayed again, possibly past 2027 state elections. The MDR would have let payment firms earn extra revenue on select UPI transactions; it was already pushed back once after retailer pushback, and government caution over opposition is driving the further delay.
items.https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tec: Intuit opened a new two-tower Bengaluru campus, now its second-largest engineering centre, housing teams across product, platform and AI that serve tens of millions of customers worldwide, reflecting deepening US tech investment in India.
items.https://www.cricinfo.com/ci/content/stor: Laura Harris hit a record-breaking 15-ball fifty as she and her sister combined for 184 runs, helping Brisbane Heat complete the highest successful run chase in WBBL history.
items.https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/art: Mauricio Pochettino, newly appointed Manchester United manager after leaving the US national team, says building the right culture is his top priority, alongside defensive issues and managing star player Bruno Fernandes. He takes charge with United 18th in the Premier League table, facing a tough opening trip to Liverpool, as he begins the job of turning around a struggling season.
items.https://www.thehindu.com/sport/cricket/i: New Zealand reached 317-6 at lunch on day two of the first Test against India in Wellington, with Glenn Phillips scoring a century before Akash Deep dismissed him. Henry Nicholls remained unbeaten on 146, closing in on 150, as he and Nathan Smith frustrated India's bowlers through most of the morning session.
items.https://www.cricinfo.com/ci/content/stor: Former England Under-19 batter Luc Benkenstein is leaving Essex for Durham, the county his father Dale captained to a Championship-winning season in 2008, following in his father's footsteps.
items.https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/art: A drone operator filmed Mauricio Pochettino's first Manchester United training session from outside the club's Carrington ground and posted twelve minutes of footage online. The operator said the flight was legal, staying in unrestricted airspace and line of sight without flying over people, though it raised questions about leaking tactics just half an hour into the new manager's tenure.
items.https://www.thehindu.com/opinion/op-ed/m: An opinion piece reflects on M.S. Dhoni's communication style as he moves into a mentorship role after retiring from cricket, recalling how he used formal press conferences and automobile metaphors to deflect tricky questions and once used the format to quash rumours of a team rift.
items.https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/19/apple-: Apple is reportedly building its own AI agent to handle computer tasks like browsing, using apps and writing code, based on a job listing spotted by Bloomberg for a senior engineering manager role. The posting describes an agent that moves fluidly between tools to carry out multi-step tasks, positioning Apple to compete with agents from Meta, OpenAI and Anthropic. Apple didn't respond to requests for comment.
items.https://www.theverge.com/tech/1038227/ap: A Bloomberg-spotted job listing shows Apple is hiring an engineer to lead development of its own AI agent that can browse the web, work across apps, write code and call services. This would put Apple in competition with Meta's Muse, OpenAI's Dots, Anthropic's Duet and Google's Tasks, several of which already offer computer-control features; Apple's Siri already handles some on-screen tasks.
items.https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/11: MIT Technology Review's AI Hype Index wryly catalogues how pervasive AI has become - from Google's costly AI Overviews to AI-powered robots and AI-assisted cyberattacks - arguing that, a decade after AlphaGo's famous match, today's AI still isn't delivering on its biggest promises despite being everywhere.
items.https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026: Internal chats reported by Reuters show Meta staff were alarmed that its Muse AI agent appeared to access users' encrypted private messages, mix up conversations between users, and surface sensitive information unprompted - including unbidden definitions and context about unrelated transactions. One employee flagged a 'possible cross-account context leak.' Meta says the erratic outputs, like random bank or bitcoin balances, weren't real.
items.https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/11: AI startup Osmo, working near Newark Airport, trains around 30 human 'sniffers' who describe odors in detail, cross-referenced with chemical analysis, to build what it calls the first foundation model for smell. Founder Alex Wiltschko claims the model has reached 'human-level olfactory intelligence,' meaning it's about as good as an average person at detecting and distinguishing scents.
items.https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/19/metas-: Meta plans to charge $300 for Muse Charm, a Tamagotchi-like wearable AI device teased at its Connect event, according to The Information; Meta didn't deny the report. The gadget lets users interact with Meta's Muse AI agent and its cute avatars, part of Meta's push into AI hardware after products like the Humane AI pin struggled to find traction.
items.https://www.theverge.com/tech/1038087/me: The Information reports Meta will price its Muse Charm gadget at $300, with a free 12-month 5G plan from Verizon included; it's expected to ship in time for the December holidays. CEO Mark Zuckerberg unveiled the device earlier this year, saying it packs the full Muse experience - including real-time voice and avatar features - into a small screen with a fingerprint sensor for hands-free access.
items.https://arstechnica.com/gaming/2026/11/w: Game designer Will Wright, creator of SimCity and The Sims, is developing MyMems, a generative-AI simulation that mines players' personal memories to create digital people who team up to solve puzzles. Due out next year from Wright's Gallium Studios and partner Artificial Agency, it 'turns the simulation inward' compared to his earlier work, marking his first major project since 2008's Spore.
items.https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-i: Nvidia's stock fell to around $150 - nearly 40% below its October 6 peak - despite a blockbuster Q3 with revenue more than doubling to $115.8 billion, driven by data-center demand up 110%. The drop came even as Anthropic's Nasdaq debut, a major Nvidia customer, priced 34% above expectations, showing investor anxiety about AI spending is outweighing strong earnings for now.
items.https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/11: A petition to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO has gathered over 115,000 signatures, including Elon Musk and figures from Hugging Face and VCs Andreessen Horowitz and Sequoia. Many signers have ties to open-source AI, models that can be run independently of big tech firms; supporters argue concentrating AI power in a few companies would leave everyone else worse off.
items.https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/19/nvidia: Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO after admitting to an affair during his 40-year marriage; US officials believe one of his romantic interests, Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy feeding information to Beijing. Megaspeed, a Singapore-based AI infrastructure firm that bought $4.8 billion of Nvidia chips, is under Justice Department investigation over suspected illegal chip-sharing with China.
items.https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026: Four Black high school students in Baltimore County are suing after an AI gun-detection system flagged one of them holding a Doritos bag as a possible gunman. School officials confirmed within minutes it was a false alarm but still called police, who responded with multiple patrol cars. The lawsuit notes over 99% of the school system's AI gun alerts have been false positives.

A nonprofit group put up Washington DC billboards linking Trump's support for reinstating Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO to the spying scandal involving Huang's alleged Chinese-spy romantic interest. Trump backs Huang's return despite Republican objections; Huang said he'd be 'honored' to return, but Nvidia's board says reinstatement isn't under consideration while an internal spying investigation continues.
items.https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/19/anthro: Anthropic's seven founders each sold about 3.4 million shares in its IPO, pocketing roughly $280 million apiece at the upgraded $83 price - more than the $250 million they likely targeted at the original midpoint price of $74. The IPO itself raised $81.3 billion for the company. Each founder has pledged to give 80% of their personal equity to philanthropy, though they can scale that back.

Anthropic's IPO could channel up to $156 billion to charity through its Public Benefit Fund, employee donations and company matching, at a $95 share price. The Fund holds 5% of shares (about $80 billion currently) and could grow via further 2% grants each time Anthropic's valuation rises 50% above the IPO price; its first commitment was $200 million to study AI's impact on workers.
items.https://inc42.com/buzz/ai-startup-disseq: Disseqt AI, which builds AI agents for governance and testing, raised $8 million (~Rs 75 crore) led by Gresham House Ventures, with participation from Sure Valley Ventures, Delta Partners, Enterprise Ireland and cricketer Rahul Dravid. The Ireland-headquartered, Bengaluru-engineered startup will use the funds to expand its enterprise customer base into the UK and other international markets, addressing demand to prove AI agents are safe and compliant.
items.https://inc42.com/buzz/anthropic-ipo-rek: Anthropic's record IPO has reignited debate among Indian business leaders about whether India can build globally competitive AI companies, given gaps in capital, research and technical talent. Indian AI startups raised $438 million across 35 deals in Q3 2026, up 265% year-on-year, and $676 million in H1 2026 - strong growth, but still short of what's needed to produce a global AI giant.
items.https://inc42.com/buzz/august-ai-raises-: Health-tech startup August AI raised $12 million from Accel, Peak XV Partners and Claypond Capital to expand its AI healthcare assistant in the US, which helps with tasks like calling doctors' offices and following up on insurance claims. The startup says it has helped 10 million people understand their health, and previously raised $3 million before this round.
